A ventro Motors: How to Change a Tyre
Changing a flat tyre is a basic and essential automotive skill for every A ventro
Motor car owner. This guide will walk you through:
• Steps to change a tyre
• Where the spare tyre and toolkit is found in all A ventro models
• General tips and safety instructions
Where to Find the Spare Tyre & Toolkit in A ventro Models
Model Type Common Location of Spare Tyre & Toolkit
Hatchback Under the boot floor in the rear compartment
Sedan Under the boot floor in the trunk

Note: All variants (Petrol/Diesel/Electric/Hybrid) follow the same compart-
ment arrangement.
Steps to Change a Tyre
1. Park Safely
• Pull over to a safe, flat location away from traﬀic.
• Turn on your hazard lights.
• Apply the handbrake.

• Turn on your hazard lights.
• Apply the handbrake.
• Place wheel wedges/blocks (if available) to prevent vehicle movement.
2. Gather T ools
You will need: - Spare tyre (found as per table above) - Jack (usually in toolkit)
- Lug wrench (in toolkit) - Wheel wedges/blocks (optional) - Vehicle owner’s
manual (for reference)
3. Remove the Wheel Cover/Hubcap
• If your wheel has a cover, use the flat end of the wrench or the provided
lever to gently pry it off.

4. Loosen the Lug Nuts
• Use the lug wrench to turn the lug nuts counter-clockwise.
• Loosen them slightly – do not remove fully at this stage.
5. Lift the V ehicle with the Jack
• Position the jack under the jacking point nearest to the flat tyre. Refer to
your owner’s manual for the exact point.
• Raise the vehicle until the flat tyre is about 6 inches above the ground.
6. Remove the Lug Nuts and Tyre
• Unscrew the lug nuts completely.
• Remove the flat tyre and set it aside.
7. Mount the Spare Tyre

text:
7. Mount the Spare Tyre
• Line up the holes and push the spare onto the hub.
• Replace the lug nuts and tighten them by hand.
8. Lower the V ehicle
• Carefully lower the car with the jack until the tyre touches the ground
firmly.
• Remove the jack.
9. Tighten the Lug Nuts
• Use the lug wrench to tighten the lug nuts in a star pattern to ensure even
pressure.
10. Replace the Hubcap or Wheel Cover (if applicable)
• Place the hubcap back onto the wheel.
11. Stow Equipment

• Place the hubcap back onto the wheel.
11. Stow Equipment
• Put the flat tyre, jack, and tools back in their compartments.
• Double check everything is secure.
Safety & Tips
• Never change a tyre on a slope or close to traﬀic.
• Use hazard warning triangle if available.
• After installation, drive slowly and get the spare tyre pressure checked at
the nearest A ventro Service Center.

the tyre, please contact your nearest:
• A ventro Service Center
• Or call A ventro Roadside Assistance (see main service manual/contact
card in your glove box)
